symptom: A decision whose caption was cleared in Studio Pro came back from describe -> exec captioned with its condition: re-describe showed `@caption 'true'` the original MDL never had. Issue mendixlabs/mxcli#1254 (0.24, Mx 11.12.4) — "roundtrip split caption does not work"
cause: Three layers each read "" as "not written": describe skipped @caption when split.Caption was empty, the visitor dropped `@caption ''` (text != "" guard), and applyAnnotations only overrode a non-empty caption. A decision with no @caption is built with its condition text as the caption (addIfStatement, addEnumSplit), so an empty stored caption had no MDL form at all
insight: When the builder DEFAULTS a property from other input, the empty value stops being the absence of a value and becomes a value that needs its own syntax — and describe has to print it. captionIsCondition already elides the default, so the only thing left out should be the default, not "". The round trip test that caught it feeds emitObjectAnnotations' real output back through visitor.Build and buildFlowGraph; checking any one layer alone passes. ActionActivity is untouched on purpose: its empty caption goes with AutoGenerateCaption, which describe already handles. Verified on testdata/expr-checker: describe -> exec reports `Unchanged microflow`.
